verdict.rationale: Poly is a file and notes workspace with a Mind/journaling feature, so publishing notes as a website is a fair question for it. The only related evidence is link-based sharing of files and folders. That is an adjacent capability: nothing shows publishing selected notes as a browsable website or digital garden with working inter-note links.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can publish selected notes as a browsable website — a digital garden with working links — without leaving the app
